changelog: Say "clear all" — in English or Bengali ("সব মুছে ফেলো") — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and everything this keyboard dictated in the current message is removed instead of typed, the Gboard start-over for a message that came out wrong from the first word, so a bad dictation no longer needs deleting by hand. It only ever removes what the keyboard itself dictated — text typed before dictating, or edited since, is never touched. Saying the phrase inside a longer sentence still types it as normal text.
